name: normest
expr: n1 = normest(A); n2 = normest(eye(5)); n3 = normest(diag([3 1 2])); n4 = normest(hilb(4));
comment: Sig: n = normest(A). 2-norm estimate via largest singular value. NOTE: numkit returns the exact value (full SVD), MATLAB uses power-iteration with default tol=1e-6 (~5-6 sig digits). Tol 1e-5 reflects MATLAB's iteration tolerance. A future perf-pass can switch to power-iteration to match performance characteristics.
